snippet.title: Leafy Corner - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Leafy Corner launches July 30, 2026!

Leafy Corner releases on the following platforms:
- Steam (Windows, macOS, Steam Deck)
- Nintendo Switch
- PlayStation 5
- Xbox (Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Xbox on PC)

Thank you all for your support and we hope you will enjoy the full version of Leafy Corner as much as you've enjoyed the demo ❤️

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558600/Leafy_Corner/ 
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018355/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/leafy-corner/9P8T7V0ZVQPC
